newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary to extend Bosnia force mandate by a year.
newsitem.headline: Hungary to extend Bosnia force mandate by a year.

text.p: The Hungarian government said on Thursday it would ask the Parliament to extend the one-year mandate for Hungary's participation in the United Nations' Bosnia peace implementation force for another year.
Hungary has 500 military engineers in the former Yugoslavia and is used as a staging post by the U.S. Army for its 20,000-strong contingent.
Mandates for both commitments are due to run out at the end of 1996.
The government will ask permission from the Parliament to extend the mandates up to the end of 1997, government spokesman Elemer Kiss told a news conference.
